standalone_loading.conclusion: Custom offline HWX exports are assigned to guarded native Asahi replay. macOS execution uses ANEForge private E5RT compilation of MIL and service-managed executable operations; the independently verified daemon MIL route also works. Historical standalone-HWX rejection controls do not constitute a pending macOS MUL execution failure. Their error classification alone does not establish physical OOM or the precise signature-check cause.
standalone_loading.independent_output_checks: Both client MIL output files match all 64 exact mathematical expectations, including signed binary fractions.

findings.problem: Empty fixture arrays allowed a vacuous successful report; mutable manifest gates could weaken the claimed fixed replay gate.
findings.fix: Validate nonempty and consistent fixtures, exact gates, port counts, finite values and hashes before either hardware runtime, then require all expected comparisons.

findings.problem: Periodic samples could miss exit-tail paging and classify an affected run as passing host gates. Lock timeout failed before a session receipt was written.
findings.fix: Bracket child launch/exit with samples; retain lock-timeout failure receipts; document the historical sampling limit.

findings.problem: Four reused captures could contain duplicate positions or come from a different checkpoint while appearing to cover the declared prefixes.
findings.fix: Require the same checkpoint, distinct positions 0/1/7/22, expected finite shapes, finite representable gains, and capture the reused-input hash.

findings.problem: Repeating compiler patching nested the temporary-path environment wrapper.
findings.fix: Skip that replacement when the environment override is already present.

findings.problem: The historical KDMA/NE explanation presented the cause of zero output and the cleanup as established without a retained native Asahi raw-versus-cleaned comparison.
findings.fix: Label the causal explanation as a hypothesis and register cleanup as a candidate fix requiring a same-runtime raw, cleaned and direct-register comparison.

remaining: Native Asahi execution of custom exported HWX is pending. Standalone macOS loading is removed from pending execution work; the private MIL/E5RT routes already pass their macOS numerical checks.
Native Asahi hardware replay, model-level checks and cross-host BF16 oracle capture still require Linux.
No rerun of the full CPU timing sweep was needed for this review; historical host-gate counts retain their periodic-sampling limitation.
